evidence: The Fear & Greed Index plummeted 12 points overnight to an extreme fear reading of 11 on 2026-06-03, down from a 30-day mean of 32.6. While deep extreme fear historically acts as a contrarian buy signal over medium-to-long horizons, acute single-day drops of this magnitude typically indicate intense panic and short-term downward momentum that often spills over into the subsequent 24-hour window. Accounting for short-term capitulation pressure, elevated volatility, and the contract rule that ties resolve as down, the probability of BTC closing higher over the 24-hour window is assessed slightly below even at 0.48.
limitations: Fear & Greed Index is a daily composite indicator and does not reflect intraday sentiment shifts or order book liquidity.
Extreme fear signals mean-reversion tendencies on multi-day/weekly horizons, but directional accuracy over a tight 24-hour window is subject to high noise.
